A '''species''' of [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]] was found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] saved the elderly [[Serp]] [[Elglih]] from one such plant during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
